article.headline: Palo Alto Networks Jumps 8.6% Premarket On $4.5 Billion Startup Deal
article.deck: The premarket price of 369.20 puts the stock back over its 50-day line, but it is still well under the 432.43 buy point of a six-week, 30.3% deep cup, and that buy point is the level to watch.
body: Palo Alto Networks traded at 369.20 before the open, up 29.28, or 8.6%, as of 8:50 a.m. Eastern. That came on top of Wednesday, when the stock closed at 339.92, up 30.63, or 9.9%, and traded 2.83x its 50-day average volume. The chart is a six-week cup, 30.3% deep, with a rim on Oct. 6 and a low on Nov. 17. The buy point is 432.43 and the buy range runs to 454.05. Wednesday's close sat 21.4% below the buy point.

The 52-week high is 432.33, and the close was 21.4% under it. Wednesday's close was 0.5% below the 21-day exponential average at 341.75, 0.0 ATRs from the 21-day line, with a 14-day ATR of 19.52. The close was 7.3% under the 50-day line at 366.70; the premarket price is above that level. The stock holds 21.6% over its 200-day line at 279.47. It ranks 96 of 99 on the desk's list for relative strength, and the RS line is 13.6% off its high. The stock is up 84.5% this year and 67.5% over the past year.

The quarter ended July 31 brought a loss of 35 cents a share against a profit a year earlier, an EPS change of -197.2%, on revenue of $3.41 billion, up 34.4%. EPS ran 0.47, 0.61, -0.22 and -0.35 over the four quarters given, while revenue climbed each quarter from $2.474 billion. The market values the company at about $278.3 billion, at 69.3 times forward earnings. The next earnings date is Feb. 16, 2027.

24/7 Wall St. reported that Palo Alto is paying $4.5 billion for a startup founded last year by former OpenAI researchers. An Investing.com premarket roundup has Palo Alto soaring as chip stocks rally ahead of the Anthropic debut.
A move back over the 50-day line that holds would leave the right side of the cup to finish; a slip back under the 21-day line at 341.75 would undo most of the premarket gap.
article.watch: Whether the gap holds above the 50-day line at 366.70 once the session opens.

article.headline: Bullish Adds 3.5% Premarket After Earnings Beat And $300 Million Buyback
article.deck: Not buyable: the stock sits 82.8% under the 118.10 buy point of a 64-week, 84.1% deep cup, below all its moving averages.
body: Bullish traded at 21.07 before the open, up 0.71, or 3.5%, as of 8:35 a.m. Eastern. On Wednesday it closed at 20.36, up 1.09, or 5.7%, and traded 3.75x its 50-day average volume. The chart is a deep cup, 64 weeks long and 84.1% deep, from a rim on Aug. 13, 2025 to a low of 18.80 on Nov. 17. The buy point is 118.10, with a buy range to 124.00. The close was 82.8% below it.

The 52-week high is 48.93, 58.4% above the close. The stock closed 15.1% under its 21-day exponential average at 23.98, -0.99 ATRs from the 21-day line, with a 14-day ATR of 1.99. It is 32.4% below the 50-day line at 30.10 and 35.4% below the 200-day line at 31.51. It ranks 10 of 99 on the desk's list for relative strength, and the RS line is 60.6% off its high. The stock is down 46.2% this year and 44.6% over the past year.

The latest quarter in the desk's table, ended June 30, shows a loss of $1.78 a share, an EPS change of -340.5%, on revenue of $32.65 billion, down 44.3%. EPS in the quarters before ran 0.10, -3.73 and -3.85. The market values the company at about $3.09 billion, at 27.1 times forward earnings. The next earnings date is Feb. 4, 2027.

Investor's Business Daily reported that the stock jumped on earnings and revenue gains and that the board approved a $300 million buyback plan. Yahoo Finance Video said the crypto platform topped estimates. Earnings call transcripts and summaries for the third quarter are out.
A recovery of the 21-day line at 23.98 would be the first change in the chart; until then it is a stock bouncing off a low.
article.watch: Whether the stock can reclaim the 21-day line at 23.98 while holding above the 18.80 low.

fundamentals.name: AST SpaceMobile, Inc.
fundamentals.summary: AST SpaceMobile, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs and develops the constellation of BlueBird satellites in the United States. The company provides a cellular broadband network in space to be accessible directly by smartphones for commercial use and other applications, as well as for government use. Its SpaceMobile service provides cellular broadband services to end-users who are out of terrestrial cellular coverage. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Midland, Texas.

article.headline: AST SpaceMobile Jumps 8.2% Premarket A Day After Offering Filing Sank It
article.deck: Not buyable: the stock is 81.0% under the 133.96 buy point of a 24-week, 81.2% deep cup and closed Wednesday near its 52-week low.
body: AST SpaceMobile traded at 27.57 before the open, up 2.08, or 8.2%, as of 8:50 a.m. Eastern. On Wednesday the stock closed at 25.49, down 2.10, or 7.6%, after touching a 52-week low of 25.16, and traded 1.44x its 50-day average volume. The chart is a deep cup, 24 weeks long and 81.2% deep, with a rim on May 28 and the low on Nov. 18. The buy point is 133.96 and the buy range runs to 140.66. The close was 81.0% below it.

The 52-week high is 133.86. The close was 29.2% under the 21-day exponential average at 35.99, -2.04 ATRs from the 21-day line, with a 14-day ATR of 3.87. The stock is 46.4% below the 50-day line at 47.52 and 64.8% below the 200-day line at 72.37. It ranks 2 of 99 on the desk's list for relative strength, and the RS line is 80.2% off its high. The stock is down 38.0% in a month, 60.8% in three months and 64.9% this year.

The September quarter showed a loss of 44 cents a share on revenue of $42.3 million, up 187.1%. Losses in the three quarters before ran 26 cents, 66 cents and 77 cents a share, with revenue of $54.3 million, $14.7 million and $31.5 million. The market values the company at about $10.2 billion.

TIKR reported the stock sank 8% Wednesday as a new offering filing revived dilution fears. Stocktwits reported the stock jumped overnight despite new shares for engines and spectrum, with bulls cheering a ULA Amazon launch clue. 24/7 Wall St. reported an earlier 5% drop after Jim Cramer called it a very hard stock to own.
Nothing changes on the chart until the stock gets back over the 21-day line at 35.99.
article.watch: Whether the premarket gain holds above Wednesday's 52-week low of 25.16.
